method: Read-only current steering, input, route, map, interaction and coverage source. Numerical rates are direct arithmetic from the source formula at constant speed; no game simulation, hidden runtime access, browser, source changes, tests or commit.

activeWorkflowContext.stateAtHandoff: Accepted Pista House pickup on Chikkadapally Road,128m,0km/h,2.5s flight,802coins,Level2 1/4; no pickup collected.
activeWorkflowContext.coverageCaution: RTC cumulative pickup count1 belongs to an earlier Taco Bell session. It is not completion of the current Pista House order.

keyboardControls.direction: A turns the car left and D right while moving forward. Steering yaw changes sign when the car reverses. A/D alone cannot rotate a stationary car because steering factor is zero at zero speed.
keyboardControls.toolLimit: These describe game input semantics, not an assertion about browser-tool chord/hold reliability.

longitudinal.units: speed is metres/second internally; HUD kilometres/hour is3.6 times absolute speed.
longitudinal.importantThreshold: S brakes at20m/s² while speed>0.5m/s, then continues subtracting speed at6m/s². Keeping S held after reaching zero starts reverse, up to21.6km/h.
longitudinal.brakeEstimate: From positive speed v>0.5m/s, time to near zero is approximately(v-0.5)/20+0.5/6 seconds, with frame discretization. At10km/h this is about0.20s; at20km/h about0.34s. Releasing all movement keys instead coasts down at4m/s²: approximately0.69s and1.39s respectively.
longitudinal.operationalHint: Near the pickup, release W/S and let the car settle to zero rather than issuing long S holds. The HUD shows speed magnitude, so a nonzero number alone does not tell forward from reverse.

steering.formula: rate=steerVis * min(1,abs(v)/6)/(1+abs(v)*0.045) *2.1 radians/second; sign reverses with speed. steerVis approaches requested steer with factor min(1,dt*8).
steering.timingLimit: These are steady-speed, fully settled-steer estimates without contact. Starting from rest, accelerating under W, braking, steering interpolation and collisions alter the actual turn. No fixed-duration hold guarantees90degrees.
steering.operationalHint: At a visible open junction, make short0.15–0.25s steering pulses with fresh scene/map observations between them. At10–20km/h the full-lock turning radius is roughly3.2–3.6m, before adding car width; a90degree turn beside a close facade may need more room than a narrow lane provides. Stop and reposition into a visible opening rather than repeatedly steering against a wall.

ribbon.geometry: The 3D pickup ribbon is a plain yellow/orange strip,1.4m wide, with no arrows or chevrons. Its color follows the pickup target; delivery switches it to teal. It is built along the checked local route prefix up to700m.
ribbon.updates: For this short route the geometry refresh interval is1.5s of game time; long routes above3000m refresh every4s. Between refreshes the car can travel beyond the strip start, leaving a stale near tail behind it.
ribbon.directionLimit: The strip itself has no visual directional markers. Looking at a long visible portion in front or behind does not establish which end reaches the pickup. Use full-map player orientation, target circle and connected road path.
ribbon.routeChoice: Ground routing uses current forward heading/carriageway. The opposite direction is forbidden across a centre median; on undivided roads an allowed reverse-direction route gets a90 cost penalty. Routing can therefore lead toward a junction away from the beacon before returning, or choose a legal turn-back route. Neither eastward movement nor increasing distance alone proves a bug.
ribbon.lastApproach: The route ends on the target road segment and deliberately omits an unverified straight driveway line through a shop/compound. The glowing target ring, visible interaction prompt and map stop identify the final pickup.
ribbon.airborne: Flying and descent hide the3D ground ribbon. Flight HUD uses approximate straight-line beacon distance; ground HUD returns to routed distance after landing.

mapOrientation.fullMap: Full map stays north-up. The player shape starts with its single front apex at(0,-14), has rear corners(10,11)/(-10,11) and an inward rear V-notch(0,5), then rotates by-yaw. The single apex opposite the notch indicates forward; do not choose a vertex solely by apparent length from the centre.
mapOrientation.minimap: The minimap rotates the world by+yaw and keeps the player apex pointing screen-up. A target appearing behind the player on this minimap is behind the car, not necessarily south on the full map.
mapOrientation.identity: The solid orange circle is the target marker; the pointed/notched marker is the car. Actual car forward is(-sin(yaw),-cos(yaw)) in world X/Z.

pickupAndHandover.acrossRoadException: The radius becomes24m only when direct horizontal distance d<24m, a route exists, and route.len>d*4+60. This is a walk-across convenience for a long road detour, not permission to collect from every point within24m.
pickupAndHandover.prompt: When conditions pass, the visible prompt says Hold E / ACT to collect the pizza or to hand over; the across-road case adds walk across the road. Hold E for at least0.9s while remaining in range and under speed; about1.0–1.1s gives practical margin if the prompt stays visible.
pickupAndHandover.collectionProof: Verify Pizza collected! Garam garam., state changing to Deliver, a new customer target and the post-collection timer/heat. The timer is reset at collection. Do not infer collection from acceptance or proximity.
pickupAndHandover.handoverProof: The same interaction gates and0.9s hold apply at the customer. Verify the explicit coin reward, changed wallet/progress and order completion. A low distance alone is not handover.
pickupAndHandover.prior16MetreAttempt: The earlier approximate16m/6km/h approach was outside the normal8m radius; speed alone was low enough. Across-road, vertical and exact target range were not established, so absent prompt there was not proof of a pickup defect.

suggestedBoundedApproach: Resume and inspect the actual current scene. Open the full map once to distinguish the notched player arrow from the target circle and identify the open street connection; do not infer direction from the unarrowed ribbon alone.

Close the map using the actual button. Use short forward inputs and observe the resulting displacement. Reposition at a visible junction if the required turn cannot fit beside the facade; use brief steering pulses while moving.
Near the orange ring, release all movement keys and let the car stop. Read the visible prompt before attempting E; a displayed routed distance around16m is not the normal interaction radius.
When the prompt appears, hold E about1.0–1.1s without driving, then record the explicit collection result. Continue the customer leg only after that result.
If the route or turn remains unclear, preserve map and scene evidence before R. A recovery changes street, heading and route distance and must not be treated as completing the pickup.
conclusion: Current source supports clear operational guidance but does not prove the previous east/west approach was a navigation bug. No browser result was produced by this analyst in this round.

timerAndMap.sourceBehavior: openMap sets paused=true. frame returns when map.open before advancing order.t; the map-close callback clears paused and resets the clock delta. Source therefore intends the map overlay to suspend delivery simulation/timer. P also explicitly pauses.
timerAndMap.browserEvidenceLimit: The root observation 125 s after collection to 102 s after a map-open/analysis/close sequence and 2.25 s of held driving is not a timer sample taken immediately before and after a known map-open interval. Unpaused tool/inspection time may be included. Do not label map pause browser-verified or infer a timer defect from that interval.
timerAndMap.operationalHint: For longer analysis after closing the map, explicitly pause with P and verify the Paused modal. Future timer verification should capture the timer immediately before opening and after closing one controlled map interval, with no driving.

controlledBrowserTimerFollowup.beforeProof: Live visible AX state before opening; not saved as a separate image.
controlledBrowserTimerFollowup.limitation: One controlled sample; no assertion about every overlay or route.
